title: Delhi Police release video of informing Dipke of grandmother’s death in detention - watch
content: Delhi Police released a video showing officers informing Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke about his grandmother’s death in detention and offering help with travel arrangements for her last rites, which he declined. The release followed his mother’s allegation that police had failed to inform him. Dipke was detained ahead of a proposed protest demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation and later released on an undertaking to maintain public order.

title: 'Your confidence is most vital': SC to Kapil Sibal after his 'no faith' remark
content: The Supreme Court on Sunday directed authorities to prevent illegal detention of people participating in peaceful gatherings amid the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests in Delhi. It also asked the Centre to ensure that metro services operate normally and internet access remains uninterrupted, subject to law and order requirements. Sibal welcomed the court's order in connection with the restrictions imposed in Delhi amid protests, saying it restores faith in the country's justice system.

title: Google helped release 3 million mosquitoes in Australia to reduce their population
content: In a groundbreaking initiative, a Google-backed project in Australia successfully cut invasive mosquito populations by an astounding 95% by releasing three million male mosquitoes infused with Wolbachia bacteria. This innovative approach created scenarios where mating leads to nonviable offspring. Observations showed a notable decline in mosquito numbers just four weeks post-release.

title: Car sends bike flying in crash, but man sitting on it escapes without a scratch
content: A devotee was injured when a speeding car collided with a parked motorcycle near a tea stall. The incident occurred at Maninagar bridge while the devotee was having tea after visiting Kulasekarapattinam Mutharamman Temple. Bystanders reported that the car driver fled the scene immediately after the accident took place. Fortunately, the person on the motorcycle escaped unharmed, but another devotee suffered severe head injuries.

title: Washington farmer challenges $618,000 irrigation penalties in state Supreme Court
content: Ron Fodé, a dedicated farmer from Washington State, is fighting against hefty penalties threatening his agricultural livelihood due to irrigation practices. The conflict arose in 2017 over water rights for his crops, leading to the Department of Ecology rejecting his irrigation assistance applications. This has resulted in penalties totaling $618,000.

title: Gurdwara body files complaint against Kejriwal, AAP leaders over Bangla Sahib row
content: In its complaint, the DSGMC alleged that AAP workers and supporters entered the gurdwara and staged protests, creating a disturbance and using the sacred premises for political purposes. "The protesters also raised political slogans inside the sacred premises, disturbing the religious atmosphere and violating the sanctity and maryada of Guru Ghar. Such deliberate political activity inside a revered place of worship has deeply hurt the religious sentiments of the Sikh Sangat," the complaint read.

title: What caused Nana Patekar’s death? Autopsy points to blood clot in major heart artery
content: Actor Nana Patekar passed away from a heart attack caused by a clot in a coronary artery. Doctors attempted to revive him for 45 minutes, but he could not be saved. His mortal remains were taken to Goa Medical College for an autopsy, confirming the cause of death. The funeral was attended by several prominent figures from various fields.

title: 'Mujhe 20L chahiye': Scientist’s daughter kidnapped, killed by security guard
content: In a heart-wrenching incident, five-year-old Aurelia was kidnapped by a security guard who not only demanded a ransom but also carried out the unthinkable act of murder. Though the guard misled her family with false claims of her safety, they were left devastated when Aurelia never returned home from a simple trip to a clubhouse. Investigations are ongoing, revealing the shocking details of this tragic case.

title: Colorado woman protects 18,484 acres of family ranch once listed for $100 million
content: A Colorado woman has permanently protected 18,484 acres of her family's cattle ranch, once listed for $100 million, from future development. Susan Nottingham's decision preserves land her parents spent over 60 years assembling, along with historic water rights linked to the Colorado River. The agreement also protects wildlife habitats while allowing the ranch to continue agricultural operations.

title: Mark Zuckerberg has paid almost double the listed price for Gothic Castle in Ireland
content: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have acquired Strancally Castle in County Waterford for more than €51 million. The couple plans to use the castle as a family residence during visits to Ireland. This historic property, originally built around 1830, includes a substantial 440-acre estate. The previous owners, Michael and Giancarla Alen-Buckley, invested in extensive restorations over 25 years.

title: Taylor Swift’s $4m Nashville education centre now showcases local student art
content: In 2012, Taylor Swift donated $4 million to create an education center at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. This center focuses on engaging children and families with the history of country music. Currently, it hosts an exhibition called Connection featuring works by students and artists from Friends Life Community. Participants learn letterpress printing techniques and create their own unique posters.

title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' mansion stuns fans
content: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ Missouri mansion has grabbed attention after a fan shared aerial footage of the sprawling estate. The property features a 50-yard private football field, a par-3 golf hole, a pond and a luxury swimming pool with a swim-up bar. Completed in 2023, the home sits on approximately eight acres in Belton, Missouri, and provides the couple and their three children with a luxurious family retreat.

title: ‘Competition of anarchy’: BJP hits out at Rahul, Kejriwal amid anti-CEC protest row
content: BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj condemned Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and Aam Aadmi Party leader Arvind Kejriwal for losing their voter base. She accused both parties of seeking excuses for their electoral defeats instead of constructive politics. Rahul Gandhi announced upcoming protests to challenge the government's actions against demonstrators. Kejriwal criticized PM Modi for police actions during protests and invoked historical comparisons.

title: Shoes fly at UP Cong HQ as Ajay Rai supporters clash ahead of new prez’s takeover
content: Supporters of outgoing UP Congress president Ajay Rai clashed with supporters of councillor Mamta Chaudhary at the party headquarters. The incident escalated into a scuffle where shoes were reportedly used as weapons. Rai's supporters demanded Chaudhary's expulsion due to perceived insults during the confrontation. Following intervention from party leaders, Rai eventually participated in the formal handover of duties.

title: From peaceful protests to free movement: 9 directions SC issued amid CJP stir in Delhi
content: The Supreme Court has instructed Delhi's authorities to lift unlawful restrictions implemented during the CJP protest. It mandated the restoration of normal functions for the Metro and railway services. The court highlighted the critical importance of allowing lawyers and journalists to perform their duties freely. Additionally, it urged for the reduction of excessive barricades that restrict movement in the city.

title: Nepal floods: Chilling videos show bridges swept away, homes destroyed
content: A sudden flash flood in Gorkha district along the Budhi Gandaki River has wreaked havoc, causing severe destruction and displacing many families. With reports of multiple homes and bridges lost, at least ten individuals are currently unaccounted for. In light of the crisis, authorities have deployed rescue teams and helicopters to aid in evacuations.

title: 'Is NHRC sleeping?' CJP alleges custodial torture of Mumbai lead
content: Saurav Das, spokesperson for the Cockroach Janta Party, condemned the alleged custodial torture of Pranay Ahire. Ahire sustained injuries from an alleged assault by Delhi Police while protesting in Delhi. The CJP criticized the silence of the National Human Rights Commission and judiciary bodies regarding the incident. Protesters reported their phones were seized by police without proper memos, limiting their ability to contact lawyers.

title: 'Cops could plant evidence': CJP alleges 'phone cloning' in press brief - top quotes
content: A Delhi executive magistrate court on Sunday ordered the release of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, on the condition that they do not engage in any "breach of peace for one year", the party's head of legal affairs, Ratna Singh, said. Delhi Police said a bail bond-cum-surety bond of Rs 50,000 was furnished to ensure "maintaining peace and good behaviour" for a period of one year.

title: Poland holds emergency meeting over possible attack on PM Tusk, defence minister
content: Polish security services convened an emergency meeting following a reported threat against Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz. Authorities have been on high alert due to recent violent incidents at schools in Poland. These incidents led to arrests and concerns about online glorification of violence among youth. Tusk emphasized the spontaneous nature of these acts, suggesting no organized group is involved.

title: Houthis exempt Mecca, Medina airports from attacks as Riyadh vows revenge
content: On Sunday, the Houthis issued a warning against using Saudi airspace for all but Mecca and Medina airports. This warning follows an attack on Riyadh's international airport that resulted in civilian casualties and fatalities. Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree indicated their targeting actions would continue based on a tit-for-tat strategy. Saudi Arabia vowed retaliation, labeling the attack a war crime and a violation of international law.

title: ‘A goat on a platter’: Ashwin explains how Hope let Sanju Samson regain form
content: Ravichandran Ashwin criticized Shai Hope's decision to keep Akeal Hosein bowling during the PowerPlay. Sanju Samson capitalized on this, scoring 82 runs off 41 balls. Despite India's strong batting performance, the West Indies managed to chase down 249 runs successfully. Shai Hope's unbeaten century led his team to level the series at 1-1. The upcoming matches could continue to highlight the ongoing challenges faced by bowlers.

title: India Youth Congress calls for mass mobilisation in Delhi on October 12
content: Indian Youth Congress has announced a protest on October 12 to defend democracy and the Constitution. The campaign is in response to allegations of electoral irregularities against the Election Commission. Rahul Gandhi and other leaders have been involved in protests against these electoral issues. Additionally, the Congress delegation raised concerns to President Droupadi Murmu regarding the electoral process.

title: ‘Going home to be with family as my grandmother has passed away’: Dipke
content: Ahead of a significant protest, Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, was detained while rallying for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities. Police claimed he was made aware of his grandmother’s demise, but family discussions reveal inconsistencies. Dipke intends to return home for family support during this tough time, while his party leaders prepare for a press conference on their next steps.

title: Watch: PM Modi inaugurates Chennai Metro Phase II stretch, rides train with CM Vijay
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched the Poonamallee-Vadapalani stretch of the Chennai Metro Rail Project on Sunday, a major endeavor costing about Rs 4,900 crore with an innovative 3.7-km double-decker design. Daily services will kick off from October 12, operating from 7 am to 9 pm with a start time at 4 pm.

title: Matt Renshaw breaks Virat Kohli’s decade-old record with stunning 190 in Durban
content: Matt Renshaw showcased his extraordinary talent by scoring 190 runs in a thrilling match against South Africa. With Australia struggling at 124/6, he rallied by combining for 174 runs with lower-order batsmen, including a spectacular 134-run partnership with Nathan Lyon for the ninth wicket. This remarkable innings was pivotal in Australia's total of 390 all out, as South Africa responded with 27/1 at day's end.

title: Rs 10L investment, different explanations: why ITAT deleted tax addition & penalty
content: The dispute arose after the income tax department received information about an investment of Rs 11.25 lakh made by a man with a wealth management firm. The assessing officer accepted that Rs 1.25 lakh had been paid by cheque, but the source of the remaining Rs 10 lakh, was questioned. Before considering the tax dispute, the tribunal had to address the delay in filing the appeals

title: History in Bangladesh! Shah creates record on first outing as Afghan Test captain
content: Rahmat Shah became the first Afghan cricketer to score a century on his Test captaincy debut, making 105 against Bangladesh in Abu Dhabi. However, Afghanistan were bowled out for 240, trailing Bangladesh’s first-innings total of 346 by 106 runs. Bangladesh pacer Hasan Mahmud claimed a hat-trick and five wickets, becoming the first Bangladeshi fast bowler to achieve a Test hat-trick.

title: Kharge says Congress to meet CJI over ‘vote chori’ allegations
content: In a significant move, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has announced plans for a meeting with the Chief Justice of India. He, alongside senior leader Rahul Gandhi, intends to discuss pressing issues regarding the independence of constitutional institutions. Kharge raised concerns about the Election Commission's functioning and criticized new legislation that he believes contributes to electoral malpractice, terming the current political landscape an undeclared Emergency orchestrated by the government.

title: 'Drishyam 3' box office Day 10 [LIVE]: Ajay Devgn starrer set to cross Rs 300 cr net today
content: Ajay Devgn's latest offering, 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion,' has marked a remarkable achievement at the box office, surpassing Rs 400 crore globally since its release. The film gained momentum with an impressive Rs 245 crore in its opening week and maintained its box office strength thereafter. By day 10, its net earnings in India stood at approximately Rs 291.96 crore.

title: NASA-backed spacecraft to test satellite repair and orbital debris technology
content: NASA has launched a washing-machine-sized spacecraft to inspect up to four inactive satellites and rocket bodies in low Earth orbit. The SSPICY mission, launched on October 1, will begin inspections in early 2027. Using autonomous navigation, sensors and electric propulsion, the spacecraft will test technologies that could eventually help repair satellites or remove orbital debris.

title: ‘Mother was pushed, I wasn’t allowed to put on slippers’: Dhruv Rathee on detention
content: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee claimed he was forcibly removed from his home by police on October 10. He reported being held for nearly 23 hours without access to legal representation or communication. According to Rathee, he sustained injuries during the incident, which he described as a kidnapping. He also expressed concerns about media spreading misinformation regarding his citizenship status.

title: ‘Wanted to kill entire family’: UP man strangles wife, 32-year-old daughter

To carry out this tragic act, he reportedly mixed sleeping pills into tea, rendering them unconscious. Neighbors noted the family's tension prior to the incident, and during police interrogation, Sahu displayed regret over his fatal decision.

title: 9-million-year-old capybara relative found in Atacama hints desert was once wet
content: the atacama desert is a landscape where water is measured in millimetres, not rivers . today, parts of this vast desert receive almost no rain, making the discovery of an animal that depended on plentiful freshwater all the more surprising . researchers identified the tooth as belonging to an extinct relative of today's capybaras .

title: Drake Maye injury update: Will Patriots QB play Raiders today?
content: the new England Patriots lost in the first match against the Seattle Seahawks and the Jacksonville Jaguars in week 3 . but the new england Patriots have managed to win in Week 2 against the Pittsburgh Steelers and the Buffalo Bills in Week 4 .

title: Steve Smith scripts history, breaks Root's Test record in South Africa Test
content: Steve Smith overtakes England's Joe Root to become the most successful fielder in Test cricket history . the catch took Smith's tally to 221 in test cricket, moving him past Root's previous record of 220 . former australia captain Ricky Ponting rounds off the top six with 196 catches .

title: Watch: Power bank catches fire mid-air, Delhi-Chennai flight makes emergency landing
content: an IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai made an emergency landing in Hyderabad . smoke began coming from the electronic device mid-flight, prompting immediate response . the plane landed safely . a passenger's powerbank is set to have caught fire inside the cabin .

title: Delhi protest crackdown: 20 FIRs registered, assault on cops among charges
content: the protest called for Kumar's resignation was met with a massive security deployment and widespread detentions across the national capital . the cases include charges of assaulting police personnel and obstructing public servants from discharging their duties . four men claiming links to the right-wing Hindu Raksha Dal have been arrested in the case .

title: Watch: CPM MP John Brittas argues with Delhi Police as they attempt to detain him
content: a row over the detention of the Cockroach Janta Party chief abhijeet Dipke and other party leaders . he criticised the police action against Dipke, ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das .

title: PM pledges to work for TN's development; Vijay seeks metro expansion, more funds
content: he said his government is working towards providing a corruption-free and inclusive administration . he made the remarks while inaugurating and launching infrastructure projects worth Rs 13,000 crore in Tamil Nadu . chief minister C Joseph Vijay sought approval for Chennai Metro Phase III, reconsideration of metro projects in Coimbatore and Madurai .

title: ‘No place to breathe’: AISA’s Neha Bora detained again, alleges police brutality
content: aISA president Neha Bora was detained again during protests demanding the resignation of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar . she alleged that police were using detention buses with separate cells to hold demonstrators in cramped conditions . in a video shared on social media, she claimed that the buses had four “cells” and that there was barely any room to breathe inside them .
